summary: Located in well run holiday village with excellent onsite facilities & potential for a lucrative holiday letting property, set on the fringe of the Lake District National Park, a great opportunity to acquire a fully equipped, one-bedroom, corner apartment with balcony & wonderful open aspect views.
description:
Conveniently located between Keswick and Penrith, with easy access to the Ullswater Valley and Northern Fells, Whitbarrow Village is a beautifully presented and maintained, fully enclosed holiday village providing luxury self-catering accommodation, with a host of leisure facilities and amenities on site.

Each property in the development is individually owned. The park owners (Seasons Holidays plc), have entered into a rental agreement with the current owner.

Under this rental agreement, Seasons use the property as a holiday rental unit, and for that pay the owners £4000 per annum, payable quarterly in arrears. Under the agreement, the proprietor is given four weeks of ‘self-use’ at no cost.

Seasons Holidays cover the annual Service Charge and the Property Insurance ( but not the Ground Rent nor Business rates ), all running costs of the property itself (repairs, renewals, utilities, cleaning etc ) and all operational costs.

The current Rental Agreement terminates at the end of December 2026

When a property is sold on the open market the new owner can let the property privately, use another agent or negotiate a new arrangement with Seasons.

Being well presented and appointed, with an open plan layout and corner aspect with views to the Pennines and Ullswater Fells, the property is well worthy of inspection

Directions From Junction 40 of the M6, take the A66 towards Keswick. After approximately 7 Miles tale the right turn by the Sportsman’s Inn where there are brown and white signs to Whitbarrow Village, off the main road. In the development, the apartment is adjacent to the main reception. PLEASE NOTE - VIEWING IS STRICTLY BY APPOINTMENT ONLY

Services Material Information Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is in a communal car park • Please note, there is no right of permanent occupation • The property is sold to include the contents, fixtures and fittings.

Tenure: Leasehold, with 982 years remaining of a 999 year lease granted in June 2008.

Council Tax: The property is currently banded for business rates. The current rateable value (1 April 2023 to present) is £2,700, however as the property is registered under the small business rate relief scheme the cost is zero.
